fields.description: Global save magic (expected by FUN_08001b08, set to ROM default by FUN_08001b20 during boot init in FUN_08001b2c)
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b08 compares savebase u16 at +0 to ROM word; FUN_08001b20 writes ROM default there; FUN_08001b2c runs this init when load/verify fails. Baseline logical u16 = 0xFAEE.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: File 0 stored CRC32-IEEE of file bytes [4, 0x70). Schema v2 has no crc32 algorithm, so stored as data (see SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: FUN_080072d4 computes CRC32 (init 0xFFFFFFFF, table at DAT_08007308, final invert) over slotbase+4 len 0x68; FUN_080015d4 stores it at slotbase+0; FUN_08001a68 verifies it. Recomputed over baseline: 0xAD62CF3D match.
fields.name: slot0_crc32

fields.description: Slot 0 in-use flag: 0 = empty slot (game falls back to ROM defaults), nonzero = saved file present
fields.evidence: FUN_08001af0 returns (u32 at savebase+8+slot*0x6c) != 0; FUN_0801bc64 branches on it (empty -> defaults, used -> load graphics pointer); baseline = 0 (fresh save).
fields.name: slot0_used_flag

fields.description: Slot 0 puppy variant selector: indexes ROM asset table with stride 0x48 and picks graphics path 0 vs 1
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c5a4 reads short at savebase+slot*0x6c+0x16, uses it as (index * 0x48) into ROM table and branches 0 vs 1; FUN_0801bc64 uses it the same way; FUN_080015d4 inits it to 0; baseline = 0.
fields.name: slot0_variant

fields.description: Slot 0 puppy appearance snapshot (16 bytes copied from ROM defaults at init, loaded into sprite/VRAM buffers on slot load)
fields.evidence: FUN_080015d4 copies 16 ROM bytes to savebase+slot*0x6c+0x18 via CpuSet (FUN_0803c72c = SWI 0xB); FUN_0801c5a4 copies those 16 bytes to stack and on to VRAM via FUN_08000d10 on slot load; baseline holds ROM defaults.
fields.name: slot0_appearance

fields.description: Slot 0 graphics asset selector A (u16 index scaled by 4 into ROM pointer table)
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c5a4 and FUN_0801bc64 read ushort at savebase+slot*0x6c+0x38 and scale by 4 as a ROM table index for the slot puppy graphics; FUN_080015d4 inits it to 0; baseline = 0.
fields.name: slot0_select_a

fields.description: Slot 0 graphics asset selector B (u16 index scaled by 4 into ROM pointer table)
